title: One requirement buried in a long tangent
transcript:
Consultant: Before we start, how is the move going?
Client: Do not ask. The new floor is not ready, the fibre was supposed to be
installed last Tuesday and the contractor has stopped answering the phone.
Consultant: That sounds painful.
Client: We have forty people hot-desking in a room built for fifteen. The
facilities team wants a booking spreadsheet for the meeting rooms, and there
is a whole argument about whether the standing desks come with us or not.
Consultant: I will not add that to the CRM backlog.
Client: Please do not. The only CRM thing I have today is that we need a
next step field on the opportunity, free text, so reps write down what they
promised the customer.
Consultant: Free text, on the opportunity. Got it.
Client: That is it. The rest of my problems are architectural.

expected.note: The only configuration requirement in the call.

notes: Desk bookings, fibre installation and standing desks are not CRM requirements. Anything extracted from the tangent is a false positive.
